proposal.target: quote_fx (FX quoting tool, spread selection for tier2 customers)
proposal.change: Apply the tier2 0.9% spread instead of the default 1.5% when the customer's tier is tier2 and the 800 EUR allowance usage is accounted for, so FX-002 returns 3231.52 as the engine expects.
proposal.diff_preview:
--- a/quote_fx.py
+++ b/quote_fx.py
@@ def quote_fx(...):
-    spread_pct = DEFAULT_SPREAD_PCT
+    spread_pct = TIER_SPREAD_PCT[tier]  # tier2 -> 0.9
     ...
-    final_amount = gross_amount - spread_amount
+    final_amount = gross_amount * (1 - spread_pct / 100)
proposal.risk: Changing spread selection globally could alter quotes for all tier2 customers and other FX cases; the trace shows allowance_applied=false, so the expected 3231.52 may also depend on allowance logic, and the test expectation's basis needs confirmation before changing code.
